title: Preferred Employer Discount Credit Amount (Apartment Home Lease)
content:
The preferred employer discount credit on an Apartment Home Lease is the preferred employer rate times the amount of the period's base rent line, rounded half up to the cent. The preferred employer rate is the floor plan's preferred employer discount rate.

## The quantities

1. **The period's base rent line** — the amount of the base rent line posted on the lease ledger for the billing period being credited, as posted.
2. **The preferred employer rate** — the floor plan's preferred employer discount rate, a decimal fraction read from the floor plan of the lease.
3. **The discount** — the rate multiplied by the base rent line amount, rounded once, half up, to the cent.
4. **The credit** — the discount is the amount credited for the period.

## Worked figures (hypothetical base rent lines and rates)

| Base rent line | Rate | Rate times base rent line | Credit (rounded half up) |
|---|---|---|---|
| $2,150.00 | 0.05 | $107.50 | $107.50 |
| $2,487.00 | 0.03 | $74.61 | $74.61 |
| $1,234.50 | 0.05 | $61.725 | $61.73 |

The third row shows the rounding point: a half cent rounds up.

## Basis Q&A

**What amount does the rate act on?** The amount of the base rent line posted for the period being credited.

**When is the figure rounded?** Once, on the product of the rate and the base rent line, half up to the cent.
